scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
eligibility_text: Families identified as economically vulnerable under the SECC 2011 database (and equivalent state extensions), plus specific occupational categories added by some states (e.g. gig or construction workers via state top-up schemes). Check eligibility on the official portal using ration card or Aadhaar.
benefits: Cashless hospitalisation cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled public and private hospitals, covering most secondary and tertiary care.
source_note: The Rs 5 lakh/family/year figure has been stable since 2018; some states run add-on top-up schemes for informal workers — check your state's health department for those.
